description: This Java class extends LayoutPsiPullParser to add custom padding behavior to layout nodes, used in Android layout rendering within the IDE. It manages padding attributes, including fixed and dynamic padding, and handles dimension conversions for layout attributes.

classes.name: PaddingLayoutPsiPullParser
classes.description: A custom parser that adds padding attributes to layout nodes during rendering, supporting fixed and dynamic padding, and converting dimension units to pixels based on device density.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Resets padding flags when a new layout node is pushed onto the parser stack.

methods.name: getAttributeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of attributes, including a possible padding attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the attribute at a given index, including padding if applicable.

methods.name: getAttributeNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace of the attribute at a given index, including padding if applicable.

methods.name: getAttributePrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix of the attribute at a given index, including padding if applicable.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the attribute at a given index, adding padding if necessary.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Returns the value of a named attribute, applying fixed padding for specific nodes.

methods.name: addPaddingToValue
methods.description: Converts a dimension string to pixels and adds padding to it.

methods.name: stringToPixel
methods.description: Parses a dimension string and converts it to pixel value based on device density.
